testcase.name: Scenario: Reopen customization after choosing a command source without editing: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:940:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen customization after choosing a command source without editing ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the Part | Tools custom target is empty ✔ When the user opens Customize from Tools ✔ Then the command source is "All Commands" ✔ When the user selects "View Tab" as the command source ✔ Then the available command list shows View Tab commands ✔ When the user closes customization without editing any commands ✔ And the user opens Customize from Tools again ✔ Then the command source is "All Commands" ✔ And the Part | Tools custom target remains empty ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the Tools ribbon remains visible
